one_line: A royal inscription scribe of the Satavahana court, carving Maharashtri Prakrit records into stone across the Deccan.

appearance.age_look: mid-20s to early 30s, slim but sturdy build from travel and stone-carving work
appearance.face: oval face with medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, sharp dark eyes with slightly arched brows, a fine tilak of pale sandal paste on the forehead, default expression focused and calm with a hint of quiet pride
appearance.hair: thick black hair oiled smooth, drawn back into a low knot at the back of the head, with a simple narrow white cotton headband tied around the forehead and knotted at the back
appearance.costume: era-accurate Deccan attire: a knee-length unstitched off-white cotton tunic-like uttariya wrapped closely around the torso and tied over the left shoulder, forming a smooth drape that covers the chest and upper arms; beneath it a plain off-white dhoti-wrapped lower garment reaching the ankles, pleated neatly in front and tied at the waist; a narrow deep-ochre cotton waistband (kati-bandh) securing a small pouch at the right hip; simple brown leather sandals; minimal jewellery consisting of a single thin copper armlet on the right arm and small copper stud earrings; a rolled palm-leaf bundle and a small stylus case tucked into the waistband indicate his profession while keeping the overall look modest and practical for travel between caves and courts
appearance.signature: a rectangular stone inscription slab held diagonally in his left arm, its surface partly carved with neat Brahmi lines, while his right hand holds a small iron chisel and wooden mallet ready to strike

ref_desc: Satavahana Prakrit Scribe with medium-brown oval face, black hair in a low knot with white headband, off-white wrapped upper cloth and ankle-length dhoti, deep-ochre waistband, brown sandals, copper armlet, holding a stone inscription slab with chisel and wooden mallet.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a Satavahana Prakrit Scribe: a slim, medium-brown Deccan man in his late twenties with an oval face, sharp dark eyes, a small sandalwood tilak, and thick black hair pulled into a low knot wrapped by a narrow white headband; dress him in an era-accurate off-white wrapped upper cloth crossing the chest and tied over the left shoulder, covering the torso and upper arms, and an off-white dhoti-style lower garment pleated in front and reaching the ankles, secured by a deep-ochre waistband that also holds a small pouch and a rolled palm-leaf bundle; add small copper stud earrings, a thin copper armlet on his right arm, and simple brown sandals, keeping all clothing modest and fully covering the body; in his left arm he cradles a rectangular stone inscription slab partly carved with tidy Brahmi lines, while his right hand grips a small iron chisel and wooden mallet, ready to carve; use a palette of off-white, deep ochre, warm brown, copper, and black, and show him from multiple angles to clearly display his consistent face, hair, clothing, and tools.
